description: We are a team of creative and motivated students from Bahrain participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026! Our goal is to use NASA's Earth science data to analyze environmental changes, especially extreme heat and climate change. We bring skills in research, design, creativity, and problem-solving. We're looking for members skilled in coding, data analysis, Earth science, and UI/UX design. Join us to create an innovative solution with a positive local impact!
summary:
Earth System Trend Detective is an interactive web application developed to help users understand environmental changes and their impact on Bahrain. Using scientific datasets from NASA and NOAA, the application explores land surface temperature, vegetation patterns and atmospheric methane trends through interactive graphs, visualisations and simplified explanations.

The project addresses the challenge of making complex environmental data accessible and meaningful. By combining scientific observations with information about Bahrain's environmental conditions, including reported methane plume detections and waste-sector emissions, it helps users identify trends and understand potential environmental concerns.

The project is important because environmental awareness and informed decision-making are essential for building a sustainable future. It also introduces users to the role of technology and data analysis in addressing climate-related challenges. Ultimately, Earth System Trend Detective aims to turn scientific information into an engaging learning experience and encourage more sustainable thinking within Bahrain.
details: Earth System Trend Detective is an interactive application that explores environmental changes in Bahrain using NASA and NOAA data. Users can investigate temperature, vegetation and methane trends through interactive graphs and explanations. The project promotes environmental awareness and evidence-based decision-making. We used Python, Streamlit, Pandas, NumPy and Plotly to develop it. Its creativity lies in transforming complex scientific datasets into an accessible, interactive experience while connecting global environmental trends to Bahrain's local challenges.
